newsitem.title: JAPAN: BNG launches $1.0 bln Euro-Asian bonds -- Goldman.
newsitem.headline: BNG launches $1.0 bln Euro-Asian bonds -- Goldman.

text.p: Bank Nederlandse Gemeenten NV (BNG) has launched $1.0 billion worth of five-year Euro-Asian bonds due on July 8, 2002, one of the joint lead managers, Goldman Sachs, said on Tuesday.
The bond will be priced 12 basis points above the yield of the 6-1/2 percent five-year U.S. Treasury note during London time at, or before, 11.30 p.m. (1030 GMT), Goldman Sachs said.
Other lead managers are ABN AMRO and Nomura Securities.
The payment date will be July 8.
The Euro-Asia bond is rated triple A (AAA) by Standard & Poor's and Aaa by Moody's Investors Service.
